effect.fr: Empêche les changements de stat en combat pendant cinq tours. Augmente le bonheur.
effect.en: Prevents stat changes in battle for five turns in battle.  Raises happiness.

flavor.en: An item that prevents stat reduction among the Trainer’s party Pokémon for five turns after it is used in battle.
flavor.ko: 배틀 중 5턴 동안 같은 편의 능력을 떨어뜨리지 않게 하는 도구.
flavor.ja: 戦闘中 ５ターンの あいだ 味方の 能力を さげられなくする 道具。
